title: The Reckoning
changes: Once a month, on the first Saturday from 18:00 to 21:00 UTC, the clans fight the Reckoning for the Crown Keep: every Crown land a clan holds scores, the Keep thrice, and so does every fight its sworn heroes win in the Crown.
The clan with the top score takes the Keep (on a tie its holder keeps it), and its sworn heroes earn 10% more gold and renown until the next Reckoning. Its banners wear a gold crown.
Every sworn hero who fought in the Crown during a Reckoning is paid gold and renown, more if their clan won, on their next login within 14 days.
The Herald warns an hour before, calls the standings every hour and the result; the war table counts down to the next Reckoning and shows the scores while it runs.
